content:
**Ally: Search and Rescue** is an ally quest for the Settler Forager in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

This ally daily quest can be given by the Settler Forager. Similar to the Settler Wanderer ally, the player can ask for more details of where the radiant location is or the enemies they can expect to encounter. Travel to the randomized location and locate the tied up settler. Defeat any enemies in the vicinity, if necessary. Once the area is clear, interact with the captured settler to set them free and return to the Settler Forager (or Hunter) at the player's C.A.M.P. Talk to the Settler Forager (or Hunter) to complete the quest.

Search and Rescue was also slated to be included in the quest rotation for the Hunter, an unused ally.
